sources.title: Republic of South Maluku
sources.note: Proclaimed 25 April 1950; claimed Ambon, Buru and Seram; APRIS invasion 28 September and Ambon 5 November 1950; Ceram guerrilla; disestablished 2 December 1963.

sources.title: Seram Island
sources.note: Coordinates (3.133 S, 129.5 E) and area 17,100 km2; guerrilla struggle 1954-1962.

notes: Rebel state added by se-04-x; the state-of-east-indonesia dossier (also written here) records the split. Disagreements: proclamation 25 April 1950 on the RMS page against 'after the cabinet formed in May 1950' on the State of East Indonesia page; end 2 December 1963 against 1962 inside the RMS page and 1954-1962 on the Seram page; the RMS page does not say when Buru was lost. Not drawn: Buru and the south-eastern islands separately; the Dutch-based government-in-exile (1966 onwards: Manusama 1966-1992 or 1993, Tutuhatunewa 1993-2010, Wattilete from 2010; no ruler strip). Page budget: 2 pages.
